personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean (adapted for Dark-First Mobile Finance)
personality_one_liner: A precision-engineered mobile expense tracker with obsidian obsidian surfaces, crisp typography, and high-contrast financial telemetry.

spacing.rule: Generous touch spacing, 16px horizontal margins, 12px card padding, sticky bottom actions with safe area inset.

do's: Use frosted glass headers over scrolling transaction lists
Apply translucent surface overlays on featured summary cards
Keep glass tint opacity at least 80% for pristine text legibility
dont's: Never apply blur to form inputs or dense table rows
Never use pure transparent backgrounds for sticky navigation

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Provides real-time financial telemetry including Total Spent, Current Month Expenses, Highest Spending Category, and quick analytics charts.

states.loading: Centered sleek emerald spinner on obsidian canvas
states.empty: Subtle empty state illustration with 'No expenses logged yet' and 'Add First Expense' CTA button
states.error: Banner with error description and retry button

screens.layout: Vertical scroll container with sticky header. Top section houses summary cards (Total Spent, Current Month, Top Category). Middle section displays Interactive Charts (Doughnut & Bar trend graphs). Bottom section renders recent transaction previews with category icons.

screens.name: Transactions
screens.purpose: Comprehensive transaction history with robust date range filtering, category search, edit, and delete flows.

states.loading: Skeleton loader rows matching transaction card dimensions
states.empty: No transactions match current filter. Quick 'Clear Filters' action button.
states.error: Failed to load history message with retry action

screens.layout: Sticky category chip filter bar at top, search input, followed by a grouped list of expense items with swipe actions or inline edit/delete triggers.

screens.name: AddExpense
screens.purpose: Fast, validated expense entry form with Amount, Category picker, Date selector, and Notes description.

states.loading: Submitting state with spinner on primary CTA button
states.empty: Form fields blank with placeholder hints
states.error: Inline validation errors for missing or negative amounts

screens.layout: Single-column scrollable form inside KeyboardAvoidingView. Numeric keypad for amount input, pill selectors for categories (Food, Transportation, Utilities, Entertainment, Housing, Miscellaneous), date picker, and sticky bottom 'Save Expense' action.

screens.name: Analytics
screens.purpose: Detailed financial breakdown with percentage shares by category and monthly comparison bar charts.

states.empty: Insufficient data for analytics graphs. Add at least 3 expenses.
states.error: Chart render error message with reload option

screens.layout: Scrollable metrics overview with category spending breakdown bars and interactive doughnut chart segments.

hero_backdrop.alt: Dark abstract financial graphic texture background

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure absolute adherence to dark-mode-first aesthetic (obsidian #121214 base, emerald #34C759 primary accents). Strictly avoid blue/purple/indigo banned hues. Implement all requested fields: Amount, Category (Food, Transportation, Utilities, Entertainment, Housing, Miscellaneous), Date, Notes. Support local storage persistence, real-time summary cards, doughnut/pie chart, bar/line trend chart, add, edit, delete, and filter flows. All interactive elements must have minimum 44x44pt touch targets and active haptic feedback.
